title: How Do Migratory Animals Know Where They Are Going? A Design-Only Framework for Testing Multisensory Navigation and Magnetoreception
framework: MAGNAV (Multisensory Animal GeoNavigation Assessment and Validation)
claim_boundary: The report does not claim an animal experiment, a free-ranging track result, an in vivo CRY4 receptor, a universal magnetic mechanism, or a single navigation algorithm shared by migratory animals.
